description.value: Pho Ever is a Vietnamese restaurant on Granville Street in South Vancouver offering authentic pho, Vietnamese sandwiches (bánh mì), and bubble teas. It serves both dine-in and takeout customers seven days a week. The Granville Street corridor is a common cycling route, making this a convenient stop for riders exploring the area.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 12m; stands (3 spaces) at 18m; stands (2 spaces) at 29m; stands (3 spaces) at 31m; stands (5 spaces) at 49m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m; stands (3 spaces) at 84m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 96m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 25 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pho-ever.ca is live and corroborates the OSM address (8178 Granville Street, Vancouver, BC V6P 4Z4) and phone number (778-379-8387). The website explicitly lists 'TAKE OUT' and 'DINE-IN' as service modes. No amenities relevant to cyclists (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pho Ever' but the website branding consistently uses 'PHO'EVER RESTAURANT' (with apostrophe). OSM spelling retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Vietnamese restaurant with a confirmed active website and matching contact details. A practical food stop for touring cyclists on Granville Street.
